Remark
[Smoothing character of the derivative estimates] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0261 ↗ thm:chow-ii-global-curvature-derivative-estimates 1. ch14:14.9\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

The factor $t^{-m/2}$ permits no derivative bound at time zero, but gives bounds of every order at each positive time. For the heat equation this rate is sharp: the solutions $e^{-k^2t}\sin (kx)$ on the circle have uniformly bounded size and gradients of order $t^{-1/2}$ when $k^2t$ is fixed.
